title: A food and calorie log
oneLine: Log what you ate, see totals.
why: A photo-to-log version was one of the three apps in a documented 'replaced my subscriptions' project. The hard part is the nutrition database, and there are free public ones.
tool: Lovable or Bolt free tier, plus a free nutrition API
keep: Barcode scanning, the enormous verified food database, the community recipes.
breaks: Free nutrition APIs change their terms. Keep your data exportable.
